gaps.info: Renal biopsy result (gold standard for confirming acute interstitial nephritis)
gaps.discriminates: Acute interstitial nephritis vs. other causes of acute kidney injury with interstitial inflammation (e.g., vasculitis, sarcoidosis, drug-induced vs. autoimmune)

gaps.info: Recent medication exposure (e.g., NSAIDs, PPIs, antibiotics) or allergen exposure
gaps.discriminates: Acute interstitial nephritis vs. idiopathic or non-drug-related interstitial disease
Acute interstitial nephritis (often eosinophil-predominant) vs. other interstitial nephritides or tubulointerstitial diseases without eosinophilic infiltration
